capabilities: Embed the OpenCode Web UI in a desktop sidebar view
Configure a separate server URL, project directory and Basic Auth per vault
Copy selected replies as Markdown with formulas restored to $...$ and $$...$$
Render missing inline and block math with bundled KaTeX
Launch a trusted local Windows .bat/.cmd OpenCode TUI launcher
disambiguation: Not a terminal emulator and a different plugin from "OpenCode CLI Sidebar"; it embeds OpenCode's web interface.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub Releases. Desktop only (Electron webview). Basic Auth passwords are stored in plaintext in data.json. Renamed from opencode-sidebar in 1.3.0 because the old id was taken; settings must be migrated manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an OpenCode agent alongside notes; users must switch to a separate browser window and lose Markdown-friendly math when copying replies.

relations.evidence: It embeds OpenCode's web interface; it is not a terminal emulator
is a different plugin from "OpenCode CLI Sidebar"

summary: Desktop sidebar that embeds the OpenCode Web AI chat interface next to your notes, with per-vault server connections and Markdown math copying.
